blocksize_benchmark_alignment.description: Live observations are benchmarked against Blocksize or a state/fair-value reference.
blocksize_benchmark_alignment.production_rule: Required for replacement analysis and agentic-payment feed quality scoring.

canonical_identity.description: Canonical symbol, asset class, and underlying identity are verified.
canonical_identity.production_rule: Required for every feed before it can enter production.

freshness_cadence.description: Observed ticks or state snapshots meet freshness and cadence requirements over a live window.
freshness_cadence.production_rule: Required for real-time production use; point-in-time probes are supplemental evidence only.

issuer_nav_alignment.description: Issuer NAV, administrator reference, attestation, or reserve data aligns with market quotes.
issuer_nav_alignment.production_rule: Required for treasury funds, tokenized funds, NAV references, and issuer-priced assets.

liquidity_depth_volume.description: Live depth, fillability, price impact, and organic 24h volume clear asset-class minimums.
liquidity_depth_volume.production_rule: Required for every live-liquidity source and every feed that contributes to VWAP.

manipulation_concentration.description: Venue concentration, pool ownership, liquidity source quality, and outlier risks are checked.
manipulation_concentration.production_rule: Required before any onchain or thin venue can influence consensus.

replayable_payload.description: Raw request/response, route, pool-state, order-book, or state payload can be replayed.
replayable_payload.production_rule: Required for QA, incident review, and deterministic feed benchmarking.

rights_and_redistribution.description: API terms, exchange data rights, issuer terms, and redistribution policy are cleared.
rights_and_redistribution.production_rule: Required for production redistribution, even for technically accessible feeds.

route_or_pool_discovery.description: Executable route, pool, fee tier, tick/bin state, or router path is discovered.
route_or_pool_discovery.production_rule: Required for quote-sweep and pool-state feeds before they can represent live liquidity.

state_instrument_confirmation.description: Blocksize state_instruments has matching pool/instrument coverage for the symbol.
state_instrument_confirmation.production_rule: Required for Blocksize state rows and state benchmark mappings.

token_or_contract_discovery.description: Onchain token mint or EVM contract identity is verified against issuer/registry data.
token_or_contract_discovery.production_rule: Required for DEX, tokenized fund, and tokenized security rows.

venue_identifier.description: Venue-specific market, coin, pair, contract, or feed identifier is known.
venue_identifier.production_rule: Required for every source because symbols alone are not executable identifiers.

policy.evidence_rule: Point-in-time token, route, state, or order-book evidence is not enough for production promotion.
policy.promotion_rule: Only rows with every required gate marked passed may be promoted to production live liquidity.
policy.state_rule: Blocksize state rows are reference/supplemental until state_instruments, state_pool freshness, issuer/NAV alignment, and benchmark checks pass.
